reviews.review: Arrowhead is one of the most predatory companies on the market right now. Love the game, hate the development cycle.

i do think this game is worth playing, but the dev need to improve some things first before i can recommend it.

1. bugs: this game has some vary annoying randomly not being able to here teammates, hellpods putting you in walls, rewards not being given to you after the mission , ect.

2. everything is payed: i know dev have to make money but they also need to give there players free bones its what peoople like to justify spending more this is a 40$ game and at bare minimum they need to in prove grinding  (i have grinded 2 warbonds it was boring + painful ) and one counity eared stratgem would be fun from time to time.

3. wack *** balance: the game is not well maintained nurfs to weapons people think are in a good spot not touching systems till they can make money from them (fire before entrenched division). some content is added just to make game game feel harder but dont add depth cuz its just meant to kill you.

4: abandoned systems: new ship modules nope. updating weapon customization na.

5: why this game is worth playing: it is really fun with others (when it works), the gun play feels grate, emotes are cool, fire is fun,  the community is awesome and i believe that arrowhaed will fix all the problems at somepoint (d2 cope still be with me after all)
end of review.

6: some things i think arrowhead should add (agree or not): the barbed wire from helldivers 1 (yes i play it and have every dlc), the motorcycle from h1, some form of armor or vehicle customization. <- this stuff doesn't need to be added for me to change to recomened its just stuff i hope they add. :)

love this game, but unfortunately the devs seem to prioritize adding new paywalled content over fixing previously added content, bugs that have been in the game for over a year, or "fixing" creative ways players go about playing the game.
enemies can walk through walls, walk just under the map while still being able to hit you, this bug has been in the game for over a year now. meanwhile the weapons they release that are fun to use get stealth nerfed. 
at times it seams that Arrowhead actively hates the player. 

get the high ground and want to rain hell on some bots bellow? too bad, these 2 ton hunks of steel can now suddenly climb a sheer cliff face just to kick your ass. 

you died and are dropping back in and want to land on that big bug thats attacking your friend? too bad, you cant steer your drop pod even though you have the upgrade.

the games writing and concept are so good, and the game play is great too. i hope, i wish, i pray that Arrowhead takes their head out of their ass and makes this game live up to its potential.
